mra.desc: The Market Readiness Assistance (MRA) Grant by Enterprise Singapore helps SMEs defray costs of overseas market expansion. SVBB is your trusted vendor to maximise this grant for Vietnam.
mra.step1Desc: We assess your business eligibility for the MRA Grant — Singapore-registered SMEs with at least 30% local shareholding qualify.
mra.step2Desc: SVBB handles the full application process with Enterprise SG — covering up to 70% of qualifying costs, capped at S$100,000 per new market.
mra.step3Desc: From market research, business matching to setting up your Vietnam entity — we execute your market entry plan end-to-end.
mra.step4Desc: Post-entry advisory, compliance support, and continued networking to ensure your Vietnam operations thrive.

packages.desc: Two curated packages — both eligible for up to 70% MRA Grant funding. Pick the city that fits your business, or let us advise.
